# S4 v2: macro-source ablation, INDB + USDA FDC (generated by scripts/fsn_s4_v2.py)

Foods scored: 61 = 15 Indian dishes vs INDB (v1 crosswalk) + 46 raw/other foods vs USDA FDC SR Legacy (mapping: fdc_mapping.csv; raw API responses: fdc_cache/). Values per 100 g. APE is undefined for reference < 1 g/100 g; those foods are dropped from MAPE/median APE only (n_APE in S4_metrics.csv).

DB values come from the current shared.food_lookup (partial tier off, empty rows = miss). DB tier counts: {'exact': 61, 'alias': 0, 'partial': 0, 'miss': 0}; no DB value for: none.

**Suspect INDB rows** (fat > 55 g/100 g): bhatura, onionpakoda, samosa. Not corrected; tables with and without.

**Circularity:** 40 of 46 raw/other DB rows equal the USDA reference (all four values within 2% or 0.2 g): apple, artichoke, avocado, banana, beans, beet, bitter gourd, blueberry, bottle gourd, broccoli, brussels sprouts, cabbage, capsicum, carrot, cauliflower, celery, chickpeas, corn, cucumber, egg, eggplant, grape, green brinjal, lettuce, onion, orange, papaya, pattypan squash, pea, peach, pear, pineapple, potato, pumpkin, radish, raspberry, strawberry, sweet potato, tomato, watermelon. For those foods the DB-vs-USDA error is not an independent accuracy measure; the last table drops them.

Qwen reproducibility: 15 of 15 Indian foods got the same post-Atwater kcal as in v1.
